scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Applies only on the positive half-line under h-bounded growth, dense range of every initial-time propagator, and finite initial stable codimension. The key equivalence uses the published all-time-codimension theorem after proving the density bridge. No independent validation or absolute priority guarantee is claimed.
title: Dense-range restoration of the one-time stable-codimension criterion for \(h\)-dichotomies
